info.title: Bryan’s reference public website API
info.description: Independent public-site intake and publication contract. Studio initiates all integration requests. Submission credentials cannot poll, acknowledge, verify payment or publish galleries. This API is distinct from the legacy Studio Public V1 API.

IntegrationBearer.description: Dedicated secret of at least 32 characters; required scope is x-required-scope on each operation.

IntakeSubmission.description: Booking additionally requires clientEmail, sessionType, startsAt and endsAt. Timestamp offsets are mandatory; endsAt must follow startsAt. Contact presence does not enable pickup notifications. Paid/confirmation claims are rejected. Omitted optional text becomes empty. Inquiry does not create a permanent Studio client.

reference.description: Legacy machine identifier, not the intakeReference.

accessToken.description: Private per-intake status credential; do not put in URLs or logs.

requiredDeposit.description: Legacy placeholder; authoritative deposit is determined at Front Desk.
